reviews.t: Love it!!!!
reviews.x: I love it! Easy access and no need to part your hair. If you have dry scalp its very good for your because the black things on top is not rubber you can actually feel it. I recommend this product 100%!!!!

reviews.t: This is terrible. The cap doesn't seal and when I turned ...
reviews.x: This is terrible. The cap doesn't seal and when I turned the comb right side up after using it, all the product that had collected under the cap dumped out everywhere. And it was a LOT. This blows.

reviews.t: SUPER LEAKY
reviews.x: Great idea. I used this bottle to quickly oil my scalp through THICK curly hair in the middle of a eczema scalp outbreak. Love the Convenience but I hated how leaky the bottle was. There is literally oil everywhere I set this bottle down. So you must be very cautious as to how you use this product and be aware that whatever the contents you put in it will most likely not to stay within the bottle

reviews.t: It will apply any liquid directly on your scalp and roots
reviews.x: This is exactly what I was looking for. It will apply any liquid directly on your scalp and roots. Each comb needle is a small tube that squirts liquid. I use it for moisturizing my scalp, which does get a little messy, but definitely less messy than before I started using this. It will work for any kind of root treatment.

reviews.t: Great Product - makes dying hair so much easier.
reviews.x: How did I live without this?  Got color on my hair in a fraction of the time - dispenses evenly to the roots only so I don't saturate my ends with too much color.  It's so smooth you hardly even need gloves.  If you color your hair regularly, you really need to have this - it makes the process so much easier. Love it and wish I had bought it sooner.

reviews.t: I'm in love. At first I thought $10 was expensive for ...
reviews.x: I'm in love. At first I thought $10 was expensive for the little bottle that showed up. But, I just used it for the first time & it's amazing. I was able to cover all my roots in half the time & with little to no mess. I have thick hair & it went through with ease. So worth every cent I paid.

reviews.t: One of those brilliantly simple inventions
reviews.x: It's ridiculous how much easier this makes root touch up.

reviews.t: ... makes applying oil or any liquid on my hair super easy. I used to take lot of time ...
reviews.x: This applicator makes applying oil or any liquid on my hair super easy. I used to take lot of time in parting my hair and applying oils/other root treatments, but this one saved a ton. The only reason for 4 stars is the price of the item. $11 is on the higher side.

reviews.t: Would Recommend
reviews.x: I use this everyday! It really helps with oiling my scalp. I have natural hair which is very thick especially at the roots and this allows me to really get into my hair. Plus I don't have to squeeze to hard to get the right amount needed.

reviews.t: Does not work as well as parting your hair for coloring.
reviews.x: When I was using this to color my hair I wondered why everyone didn’t use this to color their hair all of the time. It took 3 minutes and was incredibly neat - not a drop of color splashed anywhere. Then after washing out my color I realized it’s too good to be true, as I had a lot of missed spots. My roots are pretty grey and I color my hair brown. I also have crazy thick wavy hair, so maybe this would work better for people with finer hair. Oh well.

reviews.t: The product is well constructed but not suitable for thicker ...
reviews.x: The product is well constructed but not suitable for thicker coloring when the bottle is not full as a lot of it gets stuck in bottle.

reviews.t: Get it!
reviews.x: This little gizmo is wonderful if you color your own hair at home.  You can just squeeze on the color from front to back without all the parting and sectioning.  I couldn't believe how well this worked.  I should order another in case this one goes bad.  You will be amazed how much time this saves.

reviews.t: Easy to use. Good quality.
reviews.x: Yes it was more expensive than other similar products.  But the reviews were good and when I received it, I was surprised at how well it was made.  It is worth the extra money for the quality of the bottle and most of all for the comb which makes it so easy to apply the product.

reviews.t: Happy Oiling!
reviews.x: Similar to an applicator bottle but better! Perfect for those 4c naturals who have cornrows or two strand flatwists. Penetrates the hair follicles withoit sacrificing your protective style. Great product for gifts also!

reviews.t: Works very well
reviews.x: Love love this root comb applicator. It really gets the job done and help distribute oil in places your normal hands couldn't have reached. It's a must have for all those with hair prone to dry quickly.

reviews.t: Love it, I had to end up ordering another ...
reviews.x: Love it,  I had to end up ordering another one for my daughter.

reviews.t: Great for scalp!
reviews.x: Great for applying anything to the scalp.

reviews.t: Best root applicator I've ever owned
reviews.x: Best root applicator I've ever owned- to be fair, I've only owned two others....but this one has the widest comb and most consistent application. It's made of good-quality soft plastic that I expect will last a long time, doesn't stain and retains its shape through abuse.

reviews.t: I'm sure it would work great for applying product
reviews.x: I tried to use this to apply conditioner to my roots for co-washing and it wasn't effective. The openings in the comb were too small. I'm sure it would work great for applying product. The botttle is fairly small, but is a durable plastic.

reviews.t: Hard to use
reviews.x: This is terrible. The cap doesn't seal and when I turned the comb right side up after using it, all the product that had collected under the cap dumped out everywhere.

reviews.t: Great to apply oil in hair
reviews.x: I use this to apply coconut oil in my hair. All I need to do is take the knots out of my hair and use the comb to spread the oil evenly and effortlessly.

reviews.t: Natural ladies you won’t regret this!
reviews.x: Amazing. I have 4C type hair. Detangling/pre poo is soooo much easier. Fell in love. Well be buying more for when I dye my hair.

reviews.t: Leaked
reviews.x: The  container leaked. As soon as I tried to apply oil to my hair, the oil leaked. Impossible to use. I threw it away.

reviews.t: Awesome Product
reviews.x: Was able to apply my hair oil treatment in no time...awesome applicator!

reviews.t: Three Stars
reviews.x: Simi good. leaks a bit on the twist part. Fixed it with plastic wrap

claims.text: Users frequently praise how easy and quick the applicator makes applying product to roots and scalp, saving time and reducing mess.
Many reviewers find it works well through thick or natural hair, reaching the scalp and roots effectively.
A common complaint is that the bottle leaks or the cap doesn't seal, causing product to spill.
Some users report missed spots or product getting stuck in the bottle, especially for coloring or thicker liquids.
Several reviewers mention the price feels high, though some consider it worth the quality.
